name: Marcus Johnson
title: Licensed Real Estate Salesperson
bio: Marcus started his real estate career after fifteen years in community development, which means he understands neighborhoods not just as markets but as living ecosystems. He specializes in Washington Heights and Harlem, areas he's watched transform while maintaining the character that makes them special. His clients trust him to find the deal that's right for them — not just the fastest close.

testimonials.quote: Marcus knows Washington Heights like the back of his hand. He introduced us to three buildings we'd never find on StreetEasy. The whole process was smooth and completely transparent.
testimonials.author: James & Rosa T.

testimonials.quote: I came to Marcus with a tight budget and a long wish list. He made it work. The apartment he found us is perfect — and the neighborhood is better than anything I'd imagined.
testimonials.author: Keisha W.
